name: unknown_crouched_band
about: The see-unknown ladder on a neutral NPC (10b): a crouched player in the outer band. Admission 0x102b4760 sets the outer-band byte +0x6081 for a candidate between 0.7 x radius and the radius (npc_perception 3 -> 440 units; the player stands at 380). The attention path 0x102b3e00 (slot 472): band byte && ShouldInvestigate(player, 0) (investigate_mode 3: any player) && FUN_101671a0(player) -- obfuscated, or grappled, or FL_DUCKING and !0x101672d0; a standing player only sets ATTACK_UNKNOWN -- so the crouch is what raises SEE_UNKNOWN 0x01, sets m_hBestSeeUnknown, fires OnUnknownVisionPlayer and draws the two timers (RandomFloat(10, 20) run, RandomFloat(5, 10) start). The see-unknown sweep 0x102b15c0 then takes Roll B (the stealth arm: threshold max(0, 50 - 20 x repeat) = 50 at zero repeats, m_bFullInvestigate 0): RandomInt(0, 99) < 50 sets IGNORE_UNKNOWN, else clears it; a stationary player's closing speed 0 < 20 gives, when ignoring, SEE_UNKNOWN retracted and IGNORE_UNKNOWN 0x03; when not, INVESTIGATE_SIGHT 0x26 + UNKNOWN_RETREATING 0x07. Either breaks IDLE_DISPOSITION (INVESTIGATE_SIGHT / IGNORE_UNKNOWN in its mask) into ALERT (0x102ad660 case 1) and SelectUnknownAlertSchedule 0x102b8a60 answers SCHED_TROIKA_INVESTIGATE_UNKNOWN_IGNORE or SCHED_TROIKA_INVESTIGATE_UNKNOWN. The seed decides Roll B; both answers are retail's, so the schedule expectation admits either. ASSUMES the crouched player's sight scalar is 1.0 (StealthVisionScalarTable Light0 is 1.00 at every Sneaking): the arena has no authored world lights and the harness cannot pin the light (retail's debug_stealth_light is unported).
notes: Corrected 2026-10-04 by V2: (1) the trace prints a condition's number unpadded, 'SEE_UNKNOWN (0x1)', so the match '(0x01)' could never meet; (2) the crouch is pressed through the command bus ('elysium.cmd +duck', as verbs_stealth_kill does) and held: the bare console '+duck' reached no player in a clean boot (no SEE_UNKNOWN), while the command-bus press crouched the player for every later record of the full run (sense_beyond_vision answered SEE_UNKNOWN there, retail's answer for a crouched player). Released at 9.5 s so the posture does not leak into the next record.
